SvLiftRequest.description: The SV design and how to lift it, shared by every `sv` route: the API peer of the CLI's lift flags (`SV_FILE` / `--source`, `--top`, `--param`, `--lift-override`, `--cutpoint`, `--merge-clock-domains`). Unknown keys are refused.

cutpoints.description: Control-slice cut points: each named net becomes a free input (an over-approximation).

lift_overrides.description: Lift-only replacements of a source by file name (an assertion-macro shim, a synthesis variant). `sv verify-auto` still extracts its SVA from the original sources.

merge_clock_domains.description: Lift a multi-clock design onto the model's one implicit clock instead of refusing it: every storage cell then updates on every step. A HOLDS never transfers to the design. A VIOLATED is a run of the design only when every merged clock is on an input of its own (the run in which they tick together); with both edges of one clock, a clock derived from logic (gated, divided, muxed) or a clock with no driver in the lifted design (a black box, a cut net, a constant, undriven) neither verdict transfers. Every route reports what was merged and which case it is: `sv/verify-auto` in `notes` and `diagnostics.merged_clock_transfer`, `sv/cdc-lint` in `domains` and `notes`, the others in `lift_notes`.

source_name.description: The primary source's file name, which `lift_overrides` match (default `<top>.sv`, or `top.sv` without a `top`).

description: Request for `POST /api/v1/sv/cdc-lint` — the structural clock-domain-crossing lint. Lifts SystemVerilog with its clock domains merged and classifies every crossing of the flattened netlist. Surface peer of the CLI `mununu sv cdc-lint`.

lift.description: The SV design and how to lift it (the CLI's shared lift flags).
